Reproductive healthcare is a needed medical service. Thousands of people each year die from childbirth, and that number will only rise if necessary healthcare like this gets removed. 
A death from childbirth, as of 2023, happened once every 2 minutes according to the World Health Organization. 
Our veterans already have a high mortality rate from their stress in the service. We do not need to add to it by removing more of their healthcare.
